%% HAND-WRITTEN fragment -- NOT generated by maestro2tex (these are raw Spectre
%% runs, not a Maestro results database). Precedent: fig_pixtop_noise.tex --
%% same two-panel layout, same pgfplotsset style block, same \MaestroRoot data
%% convention.
%%
%% Data: data/eis_err_*.dat and data/eis_dph_*.dat, written by
%% ~/chips/castalia/skill/eis_trm_fig.py from
%% ~/chips/castalia/simruns/eisdemo_20260825/ac/ac_results.json (30 AC runs,
%% 0.1 Hz - 100 kHz at 10 pts/dec plus exact points at 5 kHz and 20 kHz,
%% nominal castalia_typ_25 at 37 C).  Plotted quantity is err_re / ph_err_re,
%% i.e. the chain's own error with the current measured and the applied
%% potential read at RE ("architecture A" of the campaign), against the
%% analytic Randles impedance of the load.  Values are |.| and floored at
%% 1e-4 so the log axis has nothing to swallow; the magnitude series never
%% reaches the floor, the phase series does below ~1 Hz on the resistor.
%% Series = load at the gain code that ranges it: pureR/N=0, fouled/N=0,
%% typical/N=20, fresh/N=63 (the campaign's own choices, README S3.2-S3.3).
%% Guide lines are the +-1 % and +-0.573 deg gates of afe_rev2_eis_lite.html S1.
%% The band-edge frequencies quoted in the text come from the fixed-ratio
%% campaign (ratio/band_edges.txt), NOT from these curves: here the ratio
%% R_f/|Z| moves with frequency because |Z| does.
\providecommand{\MaestroRoot}{include/analog/}
\providecolor{mtxA}{HTML}{2A78D6}
\providecolor{mtxB}{HTML}{EB6834}
\providecolor{mtxC}{HTML}{1BAF7A}
\providecolor{mtxD}{HTML}{EDA100}
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  {\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}%
  \pgfplotsset{
    eisax/.style={
      width=0.42\linewidth, height=5.6cm,
      grid=both,
      major grid style={line width=0.2pt, draw=black!14},
      minor grid style={line width=0.2pt, draw=black!7},
      axis line style={line width=0.4pt, draw=black!45},
      tick style={line width=0.4pt, draw=black!45},
      tick align=outside,
      label style={font=\small}, tick label style={font=\small},
      legend style={font=\scriptsize, draw=none, fill=white,
                    fill opacity=0.85, text opacity=1, row sep=1pt,
                    legend columns=2, column sep=4pt},
      every axis plot/.append style={line join=round, line width=0.9pt,
                                     mark size=1.0pt},
      xlabel={Frequency~[\si{\hertz}]},
      xmin=0.1, xmax=1e5, xtick={1e-1,1e0,1e1,1e2,1e3,1e4,1e5},
    }}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[eisax, xmode=log, ymode=log,
      ylabel={Magnitude error~[\si{\percent}]},
      ymin=1e-3, ymax=100,
      legend style={at={(0.03,0.97)}, anchor=north west},
    ]
      \addplot[mtxA, mark=*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_err_pureR.dat};
      \addlegendentry{\SI{11}{\kilo\ohm} resistor, \(N=0\)}
      \addplot[mtxB, mark=square*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_err_fouled.dat};
      \addlegendentry{fouled, \(N=0\)}
      \addplot[mtxC, mark=triangle*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_err_typical.dat};
      \addlegendentry{typical, \(N=20\)}
      \addplot[mtxD, mark=diamond*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_err_fresh.dat};
      \addlegendentry{fresh, \(N=63\)}
      \addplot[black!55, line width=0.7pt, densely dotted, no marks,
        domain=0.1:1e5, samples=2] {1};
    \end{axis}
  \end{tikzpicture}\hfill
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[eisax, xmode=log, ymode=log,
      ylabel={Phase error~[\si{\degree}]},
      ymin=1e-3, ymax=100,
      legend style={at={(0.03,0.97)}, anchor=north west},
    ]
      \addplot[mtxA, mark=*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_dph_pureR.dat};
      \addlegendentry{\SI{11}{\kilo\ohm} resistor, \(N=0\)}
      \addplot[mtxB, mark=square*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_dph_fouled.dat};
      \addlegendentry{fouled, \(N=0\)}
      \addplot[mtxC, mark=triangle*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_dph_typical.dat};
      \addlegendentry{typical, \(N=20\)}
      \addplot[mtxD, mark=diamond*] table {\MaestroRoot data/eis_dph_fresh.dat};
      \addlegendentry{fresh, \(N=63\)}
      \addplot[black!55, line width=0.7pt, densely dotted, no marks,
        domain=0.1:1e5, samples=2] {0.573};
    \end{axis}
  \end{tikzpicture}}
  \caption[{Measured impedance error against frequency for four loads.}]{Measured
  impedance error against frequency --- magnitude (left) and phase (right) ---
  for the calibration resistor and the three electrode cases, each at the gain
  code that ranges it, with the applied potential read at the reference electrode
  and the current measured. Error is taken against the analytic impedance of the
  load, so these are the chain's errors and not the model's; dotted lines are the
  \SI{1}{\percent} and \SI{0.573}{\degree} gates. Each curve turns up where the
  electrode's impedance has collapsed toward \(R_u = \SI{1}{\kilo\ohm}\) and the
  noise gain \(1 + R_f/|Z|\) has therefore risen, which is why the highest-gain
  case is the most accurate below \SI{100}{\hertz} and the first to degrade above
  \SI{1}{\kilo\hertz}. The gate crossings here are not the bandwidth
  specification: the ratio \(R_f/|Z|\) moves with frequency on a real electrode,
  and the specification comes from the fixed-ratio measurement of
  Section~\ref{sss:eis-coverage}.}
  \label{fig:eis-error}
\end{figure}
